Name: Infectious and Undetectable by Microscopy Humans

Description: Infection of susceptible humans by an infectious mosquito, leading to symptomatic disease.
Infection of susceptible humans by an infectious mosquito, leading to asymptomatic disease.
Prophylaxis given to uninfected individuals during mass drug administration (MDA).
Progression from symptomatic to asymptomatic infection, either naturally or due to treatment failure.
Successful treatment of symptomatic individuals.

Target: Infectious and Undetectable by Microscopy Humans
Description: Progression from asymptomatic patent infection to sub-patent infection.
Successful treatment of asymptomatic individuals during mass drug administration (MDA) or mass screen and treat (MSAT).
Natural recovery from sub-patent infection back to a susceptible state.
Successful treatment of sub-patent individuals during mass drug administration (MDA) or mass screen and treat (MSAT).
Recovery from infection following treatment, leading to a period of prophylactic protection.
Waning of prophylactic protection, returning individuals to a susceptible state.
Infection of susceptible mosquitoes from biting an infectious human (D, A, U, or T).
Development of parasites within the mosquito, after which the mosquito becomes infectious.

Name: ACT efficacy
Description: Efficacy of Artemisinin-combination therapies (ACTs) at clearing parasites.

Name: Non-ACT efficacy
Description: Efficacy of non-ACT treatments at clearing parasites, assuming resistance.

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia (non-artemisinins)
Description: Duration of infectiousness to mosquitoes after treatment with non-artemisinins.

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia (ACT)
Description: Duration of infectiousness to mosquitoes after treatment with ACT.

Name: Duration of gametocytaemia (ACT-PQ)
Description: Duration of infectiousness to mosquitoes after treatment with ACT plus primaquine.

Name: Prophylaxis duration (short-acting)
Description: Duration of inhibitory antimalarial blood concentration for a short-acting drug.

Name: Prophylaxis duration (long-acting)
Description: Duration of inhibitory antimalarial blood concentration for a long-acting drug.

Name: Infectiousness reduction (non-artemisinins)
Description: Reduction in average infectiousness to mosquitoes following treatment with non-artemisinins.

Name: Infectiousness reduction (ACT, ACT-PQ)
Description: Reduction in average infectiousness to mosquitoes following treatment with ACT or ACT-PQ.

Name: Correlation in MDA participation
Description: Correlation in an individual's probability of participating in successive rounds of MDA.

Name: Relative infectivity of Asymptomatic Humans
Description: Infectivity of asymptomatic cases (A) relative to symptomatic cases (D).

Name: Relative infectivity of Subpatent Humans
Description: Infectivity of subpatent cases (U) relative to symptomatic cases (D).

Name: MDA coverage
Description: Assumed coverage for mass drug administration simulations.
